limitations: The starting control is naturally observed and is not a matched-payload performance benchmark.
Every carried endpoint/stream needs sufficient comparable samples during the window; zero or noncomparable samples remain INSUFFICIENT.
Interruptions or executor/config changes invalidate this window; previous windows cannot be joined.
schedule: Every 10 minutes until the starting sample; hourly after confirmation
user_trigger: User will send Responses SSE with an existing canary Key; no raw credential requested
notification_policy: Only meaningful start, anomaly, interruption, action-required or completion
